lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Hey, Weakling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I couldn't care less about you,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: but if you can't perform adequately,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: it'll hinder our mission, don't you think?
What are you getting at?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Have you been eating properly?
What makes you ask?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Just answer the question.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Have you been eating properly?
I guess.
My diet mainly consists of instant food.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I guess...?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You talk like someone

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: who doesn't give a damn about their own body.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Tsk,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: that's why you'll always be weak!
Why are you so interested in my diet all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Last time I saw you, you looked like a walking corpse.
Come on, it's not that bad.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: A healthy body contributes to a healthy mind.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Didn't they teach you that at the military academy?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Nothing irritates me more than

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: seeing someone neglect and mistreat their own health.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Also...
There's more?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What's up with those dark circles

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: under your eyes?
Work has been keeping me up lately.
I've been staying up late binge-watching TV shows.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You moron.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Sleep is paramount

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: to maintaining proper focus on the battlefield.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Are you in the Commander's Room now?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't move,

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'm coming over there to set you straight.
I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: And one more thing.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What in the world is going on with your shirt?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It's full of wrinkles.
I haven't had time to iron it.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Jeez, give me a break...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: How can you expect other units to respect us

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: when you step outside looking like a bum?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: You should at least dress prim and proper.
You seem to have a lot of interest in me.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Don't be an idiot.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I shouldn't have to remind you that

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: those who don't take care of themselves off the battlefield are the first ones to die.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Take my advice and pull yourself together. I don't care how busy you are.
Got it, thanks!
